user.title: HomeKit Bridge Plus
user.description: How should this be paired with HomeKit?

bridge.title: Create a HomeKit bridge
bridge.description: Each bridge is paired separately in the Apple Home app and can hold up to 150 accessories. You can choose entities now or later in the options, where you can also configure each one.

accessory.title: Create a standalone accessory
accessory.description: One entity, paired on its own. Use this for TVs and receivers (Apple only shows those properly this way) and for the best camera experience. You can configure it in the options afterwards.

error.port_used: Another HomeKit Bridge Plus bridge already uses this port.
error.port_in_use: This port is already in use on this machine (the built-in HomeKit Bridge maybe?).
error.entity_missing: This entity has no state yet.

menu_options.filters: Include by label / area / domain, and exclude
menu_options.configure_entity: Configure an entity (type, name, features, battery…)
menu_options.groups: Combined accessories (several entities in one tile)

select_entities.title: Choose entities
select_entities.description: Entities chosen here are always exposed.

filters.title: Automatic includes
filters.description: Everything matching a label, area or domain is exposed too, and the bridge reloads by itself when it changes. Hidden, disabled, config and diagnostic entities are skipped. Tip: create a label such as "HomeKit" and put it on the entities or devices you want to expose.

configure_entity.title: Configure an entity
configure_entity.description: Pick an exposed entity. ✎ = already customized.

entity_type.title: {name}
entity_type.description: `{entity_id}`: choose how it shows up in HomeKit.

entity_options.title: Options
entity_options.description:
`{entity_id}` as **{type}**. Only what you tick here is exposed to HomeKit.

TV remote keys without a matching service fire the `homekit_plus_tv_remote_key_pressed` event (with `entity_id` and `key_name`) so you can handle them in automations.

data.stream_source: Stream URL override (empty = camera's own stream)
data.video_codec: Video encoder (copy = no re-encoding, lowest CPU, needs H.264 source)
data.linked_motion_sensor: Motion sensor shown on the camera

groups.title: Combined accessories
groups.description: A combined accessory shows several entities as one accessory in HomeKit, for example a multi sensor or a ceiling fan with a light. Each entity keeps its own type and options.

data.name: Name
data.entities: Entities (the first one decides the icon)

bridge.title: Bridge settings
bridge.description: Pairing code: **{pin}**. If you change the port, iOS may need a moment to find the bridge again.

data.name: Bridge name
data.advertise_ip: Advertised IP address (optional, for multiple network interfaces or Docker)

unpair.name: Unpair
unpair.description: Removes all pairings so the bridge can be added to HomeKit again.
